DB.description: D1 database for mail, users, and threads.

ATTACHMENTS.description: R2 bucket for inbound and outbound attachments.

EMAIL_PROVIDER.description: Mail provider: `resend` (default, any DNS host) or `cloudflare` (requires Cloudflare DNS + Workers paid plan).

CLOUDFLARE_MAIL_DOMAINS.description: Keep `example.com` for Resend. For `EMAIL_PROVIDER=cloudflare`, replace with your domain onboarded in [Email Service](https://developers.cloudflare.com/email-service/) (comma-separated, e.g. `yourdomain.com`).

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Only for `EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend`: full-access key from [Resend API keys](https://resend.com/api-keys). Keep the placeholder if using Cloudflare Email.

RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Only for `EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend`: shown once when you create the webhook at [Resend webhooks](https://resend.com/webhooks). Keep the placeholder if using Cloudflare Email.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Optional. TypeSafe key for inbox tabs (Primary, Social, Promotions, Updates, Forums) and spam. Keep the placeholder to skip — mail stays in Primary.
